en:
This school is missing something, and I finally
figured out what it is!

A martial arts dojo! What kinda school doesn't
have a dojo!? I mean, come on!

There's gotta be a dojo somewhere!
Let's go look for it together!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time searching the school for
a dojo with Tenko...
<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko and I grew a little closer today.
